_about.description: Generation Zero health and damage values: machine component health per layout, each machine weapon once with the machines that use it, plus every player weapon (DLC included) with per-ammo damage and per-quality multipliers.
_about.source: Read from the game's own tuning files (layout .epe files, .ammotunec projectile tuning, .ftunec blast tuning, weapon_tuning.bin and difficulty_settings) using the DECA-Dec-26 extractor, and machine senses from settings/hp_settings/animal_senses.bin.

reading_the_numbers.health_each: Hit points of one component of that kind. Armour plates are listed separately.
reading_the_numbers.total_component_health: All component and armour hit points added up. The game keeps no separate overall health bar value in a readable file, so use this as a size comparison, not an exact kill threshold.
reading_the_numbers.damage_per_projectile: Damage one bullet/pellet does to the player before difficulty scaling.
reading_the_numbers.blast: Area damage when the projectile or attack explodes: damage to players / machines and radius in metres.
reading_the_numbers.damage_over_time: Burn, gas or radiation: damage_per_tick every tick_seconds for duration_seconds (refreshed while you stay in it).
reading_the_numbers.contact: Melee damage from a part that hurts you while you touch it: damage_to_players_min..max per hit within radius_vs_players_m, repeating every repeat_interval_seconds while you stay in reach.
reading_the_numbers.projectile_damage: Player weapons: base damage of one projectile at the best non-experimental quality (multiplier 1.0).
reading_the_numbers.armour_multiplier / component_multiplier: How much of that damage goes into armour plates and into components.
reading_the_numbers.damage_multiplier_by_quality: Multiply projectile_damage by this for the weapon quality you have.
reading_the_numbers.difficulty: Multipliers applied on top of everything, per difficulty and number of players.
reading_the_numbers.detection: machine_detection: how far each machine class can see (sight_m) and hear (hearing_m) you per stance. max = farthest distance at which it starts to notice you; full_speed_within = inside this it notices you at the full rate. Detection is a score that builds while you are seen or heard and drains by drain_per_second; at search_at the machine starts searching, at attack_at it attacks. unaware = normal state, alerted = searching or fighting. field_of_view_deg is the width of the vision cone. night_sight_multiplier applies to sight from 19:00 to 07:00.

_about.dlc_packs: Pack names are matched from the content groups in the item table.

Gas Canister Drop.note: The dropped canister explodes when shot or hit; blast values shown.

Gnome Melee Hit.note: Ticks hurt you by latching on; the bite file gives no direct damage to players.

Melee Bite – Tick (Military).note: Ticks hurt you by latching on; the bite file gives no direct damage to players.

Melee Bite – Tick (Prototype).note: Ticks hurt you by latching on; the bite file gives no direct damage to players.

Recovery Field Emitter.note: Heals nearby machines; it does not damage you.

Sawblade.note: Spinning saw on the Lynx's front, present in every Lynx layout. Its damage is the AreaDamage component on the layout's "Sawblade" part (model lynx_saw_blade); it hits players only, not machines. The game's machine descriptions list it as "Sawblade".

Toxic Melee Bite.note: Ticks hurt you by latching on; the bite file gives no direct damage to players.

Turret Drop.note: Dropped turret: per-bullet damage, plus a small explosion when it is destroyed.
